frequency_question: How often do announced major tariffs by U.S. presidents get fully implemented when capability is assumed?
membership_rule: Includes explicitly announced, major tariff actions or sectoral tariff threats by a U.S. President where executive authority is claimed. Excludes minor anti-dumping duties or routine administrative tariffs.

cases.name: Trump Section 232 Steel and Aluminum Tariffs

coverage_note: 9 named major tariff implementation instances since 1970; all announced major tariffs backed by executive will were enacted.
known_gaps: Excludes minor retaliatory measures that were quickly withdrawn before implementation due to immediate pre-negotiations.
validity_reason: Valid through the duration of the current executive authority framework regarding trade tariffs.
